urls.title: Websites
urls.description: Domains or URLs to analyze, e.g. "shopify.com" or "https://example.com/pricing". Duplicates are removed.

minConfidence.title: Minimum confidence
minConfidence.description: Only report technologies detected with at least this confidence (0–100).

includeDetails.title: Include details
includeDetails.description: Include website, icon and description for each technology. Turn off for smaller output.

maxConcurrency.title: Max concurrency
maxConcurrency.description: How many websites to analyze in parallel.

timeoutSecs.title: Timeout per website (seconds)
timeoutSecs.description: Give up on a website after this many seconds (slow or unresponsive sites are not charged).
